bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (WebProcessPool::eval), springboard/sdk/src/webview_dev.rs (dev_eval, DevEvent::Eval); no standalone JS context in the SDK
summary: JavaScriptCore lets an app run JavaScript on its own, exchange values with it, and expose its objects to scripts. BifrOSt now has the JsContext equivalent (bifrost_app::js_context: a standalone Boa realm, typed values, host functions, exceptions, console capture) and still runs scripts inside a web view through evaluateJavaScript. Missing: a shared virtual machine, managed values, exporting Rust types as classes, timers, and the C API.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/js_value.rs (JsValue::from_eval, JsValue::to_literal); springboard/sdk/src/script_value.rs (ScriptValue); springboard/src/shell/browser/js/mod.rs (one Boa Context per browser tab, internal to the Browser); springboard/src/shell/js_context.rs (JsContext); springboard/sdk/src/js_context.rs (bifrost_app::js_context)
features.note: 2026-10-19: apps get a standalone context. JsContext is a fresh Boa realm with no DOM, network, timers or file access, evaluate_script at global scope (var and function definitions persist between calls), loop, recursion and stack limits that turn a runaway script into an exception, console capture with levels, and a source size cap. Still missing: JSVirtualMachine sharing between contexts, JSManagedValue, garbage collector hooks, import, timers. Midget check: host tests `shell::js_context::tests::globals_persist_between_evaluations`, `a_runaway_script_is_stopped`, `there_is_no_dom_network_or_timer_in_a_context` (cargo test -p springboard js_context) and `bifrost_app::js_context::tests::*`; no Midget click path, no app uses it yet.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/js_value.rs (JsValue::from_eval, JsValue::to_literal); springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (WebViewEvent::EvalResult, a String); springboard/sdk/src/webview_dev.rs (EvalValue { ty, json }); springboard/src/shell/js_context.rs (JsOut); springboard/sdk/src/js_context.rs (to_js_value, to_json)
features.note: 2026-10-19: JsOut reads undefined, null, booleans, numbers (NaN and the infinities kept), strings, bigints (decimal text), symbols (description), functions (source text), arrays and objects (fields in script order; a cycle is an exception); set_value writes JSON into a global; js_context::to_js_value and to_json convert to and from the SDK JsValue. Still missing: object identity across calls (values are copied out), a function value cannot be called again from Rust, DOM elements are not applicable in a standalone context. Midget check: host tests `shell::js_context::tests::scripts_return_typed_values`, `arrays_and_objects_keep_their_shape_and_order`, `a_cycle_is_an_exception_not_a_hang` and `bifrost_app::js_context::tests::results_arrive_as_sdk_values_and_values_go_back_in`.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs:320 (WebView eval, one line of JS, answer as EvalResult); springboard/sdk/src/webview_dev.rs (dev_eval with token); springboard/sdk/src/js_context.rs (evaluate, set_global, JsContext::set_function)
features.note: 2026-10-19: scripts run without a web view: evaluate_script returns the last expression as a typed value, a promise result is settled by running its jobs (a promise that needs a timer or I/O is reported as an exception), and set_function exposes a Rust closure to scripts as a global (JSON arguments in, JSON out, an Err is thrown as an Error). In a web view, evaluateJavaScript is unchanged and Servo 0.7.0 evaluate_javascript still does not await promises. Still missing: exporting Rust types as classes with methods (JSExport on objects), calling a script function value from Rust later. Midget check: host tests `shell::js_context::tests::host_functions_take_and_return_json_and_can_fail`, `promises_settle_or_report_that_they_cannot`, `values_go_in_as_globals`; in the Browser, `browser.eval` still runs in the page.

features.apple: JSContext exception handler, WKWebView alert and confirm panels (not JavaScriptCore)
features.note: 2026-10-19: dialogs raised by page scripts are covered as before (WebViewEvent::Dialog, dialog_reply). The exception handler for standalone scripts now exists: every uncaught exception comes back as JsException (name, message, stack text) and is passed to set_exception_handler before evaluate_script returns it; exception() holds the last one until a later evaluation succeeds. Still missing: line and column of the error as separate fields, source URLs for scripts. Midget check: host test `shell::js_context::tests::exceptions_carry_name_and_message_and_reach_the_handler`.

gaps: No SDK type for a standalone JavaScript context (JSContext equivalent), so apps cannot run scripts without a web view
No way to expose app objects or functions to scripts (JSExport equivalent)
No value bridge between app code and script values beyond text and JSON strings from a web view
No syntax check and no standalone script error reporting outside a web view
Boa (springboard/src/shell/browser/js/mod.rs) is only wired into the Browser; it could back an SDK context but the SDK does not expose it
Servo 0.7.0 evaluate_javascript does not await promises, so async script results from a web view are incomplete
